customhud.config.title: Beautiful Day Counter
customhud.config.days.tooltip: Show the current day with the game mode icon.
customhud.config.bossbar.tooltip: Show a colored bar tracking the day/night cycle.
customhud.config.position.tooltip: Place the HUD at the top or above the hotbar.
customhud.config.night_ticks.tooltip: Small marks on the bar where the night starts and ends.
customhud.config.sleep_icon.tooltip: The clock icon turns into a bed when you can sleep.
customhud.config.moon_phase.tooltip: Show the current moon phase. Useful for slimes, cats and farms.
customhud.config.countdown.tooltip: Show the real time left until night (or until day).
customhud.config.scale.tooltip: Make the whole HUD bigger or smaller.
customhud.config.opacity.tooltip: Make text and bar more see-through. Item icons stay solid.
customhud.config.background.tooltip: A dark see-through panel behind the HUD, easier to read on snow and bright skies.
customhud.config.theme.tooltip: Color palette of the day/night bar.
customhud.config.offset_x.tooltip: Shift the HUD left (negative) or right (positive).
customhud.config.offset_y.tooltip: Shift the HUD up (negative) or down (positive).
customhud.config.dimensions.tooltip: There is no day/night cycle there: show the Overworld time, show ??:?? like the vanilla clock, or hide clock and bar.
customhud.config.milestones.tooltip: Rainbow day counter and special icon on days 50, 100, 365...
customhud.config.milestone_sound.tooltip: Play a sound when a milestone day starts.
